text: LORVAN, Sept. 18 — Anselm Reyes has been appointed chief conductor of the Halewyn Philharmonic, people familiar with the matter said. The orchestra’s board approved the move late Tuesday after a closed vote at its quarterly session in Lorvan, according to the people, who asked not to be named discussing personnel decisions. Reyes, 41, is set to begin a three-year term in January and will lead the ensemble’s spring tour across Marrow, Vint, and Calde. He succeeds Mara Seln, who stepped down in June after eight seasons. A formal announcement is expected Friday, alongside details of Reyes’s inaugural program, which is expected to feature works by Soren Vale and Ilya Kest.
